posting.content: Who we are About Stripe Stripe, LLC. is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. What you’ll do Responsibilities Design, build, and operate critical tier-0 backend services that must achieve 99.99%+ availability and handle security-sensitive data. Responsible for improving developer tooling. Design and implement robust, scalable infrastructure, participate in an on-call rotation, and collaborate with engineering teams across the company to plan and safely execute changes in production. Set up and operate infrastructure that participates in decentralized distributed systems, including creating deploy pipelines for artifacts. Build and harden custom Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) used to bootstrap EC2 instances, and implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for these systems. Participate in roadmap planning and prioritization. Deliver value through a strong collaborative approach with multiple customers and stakeholders across Stripe. Who you are Minimum requirements Must have a Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science or a related field, plus three (3) years of software engineering or related experience. Must have three (3) years of experience in each of the following: Cloud technologies, including AWS and Azure; Go, Python or Java; Developing, maintaining and debugging distributed systems; Linux OS; Metrics, alarms and dashboards; NoSQL databases; and Handling critical incidents for production systems. Salary: $156,800 - $235,200/yr This salary range represents the base salary range for the role and any sales commissions/sales bonuses targets, if applicable, would be in addition to the base salary. 40 hrs/week 50% Telecommuting permitted. Multiple Positions Available. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends. WA61 #LI-DNI
posting.title: Software Engineer

bullets: Migrated a patient-portal front end from server-rendered pages to React and TypeScript, one route at a time behind feature flags.
Built Node.js and Express REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL for appointment and billing flows.
Added Sentry error tracking with a redaction layer so health data never left the service.
Cut median page load on the busiest route by roughly a third by caching reference data in Redis.
Maintained Java and Spring Boot order-service microservices that published events to RabbitMQ.
Made order-event consumers idempotent and added a dead-letter queue after a duplicate-charge incident.
Wrote integration tests with Testcontainers and ran them in a GitHub Actions pipeline.
Event-ingestion service in TypeScript on Node.js with a RabbitMQ work queue and retry with backoff.
Load-tested with k6 and documented the throughput ceiling and where it broke.
Spring Boot REST API with JSON Schema validation, ETag caching, and asynchronous indexing into Elasticsearch.

excluded: roles requiring U.S. citizenship or security clearance
